passages.text: Now the Reubenites and Gadites, who had very large herds and flocks, surveyed the lands of Jazer and Gilead, and they saw that the region was suitable for livestock.
passages.sermon:
The Reubenites and the Gadites had very large herds and flocks.
They owned many animals.
They looked at the land of Jazer.
They looked at the land of Gilead.
They saw these places.
They saw that the land was good for livestock.
The region was suitable for keeping animals.
passages.original: וּמִקְנֶ֣ה׀ רַ֗ב הָיָ֞ה לִבְנֵ֧י רְאוּבֵ֛ן וְלִבְנֵי־ גָ֖ד עָצ֣וּם מְאֹ֑ד וַיִּרְא֞וּ אֶת־ אֶ֤רֶץ יַעְזֵר֙ וְאֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ גִּלְעָ֔ד וְהִנֵּ֥ה הַמָּק֖וֹם מְק֥וֹם מִקְנֶֽה׃

passages.text: So the Gadites and Reubenites came to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of the congregation, and said, “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon, which the LORD conquered before the congregation of Israel, are suitable for livestock—and your servants have livestock.”
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Gad and the tribe of Reuben had many herds and flocks.
The men from Gad and Reuben came to Moses.
They also came to Eleazar the priest.
They also came to the leaders of the congregation of Israel.
They spoke to them.
They said the names of several places.
These places were Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon.
The LORD had conquered these lands before the congregation of Israel.
These lands are good for livestock.
Your servants have livestock.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ בְנֵֽי־ גָ֖ד וּבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאֶל־ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶל־ נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ עֲטָר֤וֹת וְדִיבֹן֙ וְיַעְזֵ֣ר וְנִמְרָ֔ה וְחֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵ֑ה וּשְׂבָ֥ם וּנְב֖וֹ וּבְעֹֽן׃ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לִפְנֵי֙ עֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֥רֶץ מִקְנֶ֖ה הִ֑וא וְלַֽעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ מִקְנֶֽה׃ס

passages.text: “If we have found favor in your sight,” they said, “let this land be given to your servants as a possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan.”
passages.sermon:
The Gadites and Reubenites spoke to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of Israel.
They said, “We are your servants.
If we have found favor in your sight, please listen to us.
Let this land be given to your servants as a possession.
Do not make us cross the Jordan.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אִם־ מָצָ֤אנוּ חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ יֻתַּ֞ן אֶת־ הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את לַעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ לַאֲחֻזָּ֑ה אַל־ תַּעֲבִרֵ֖נוּ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

passages.text: But Moses asked the Gadites and Reubenites, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
passages.sermon: Moses spoke to the men from the tribe of Gad and the tribe of Reuben.\r\nHe said, “Your brothers will go to war.\r\nWill you stay here and not go with them?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִבְנֵי־ גָ֖ד וְלִבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן הַאַֽחֵיכֶ֗ם יָבֹ֙אוּ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְאַתֶּ֖ם תֵּ֥שְׁבוּ פֹֽה׃

passages.text: Why are you discouraging the Israelites from crossing into the land that the LORD has given them?
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the Gadites and Reubenites.
He asked them a question.
He said, “Why are you discouraging the Israelites?”
The Israelites are God’s chosen people.
God gave the Israelites the land across the Jordan.
You are making them not want to cross into the land.
God gave this land to them.”
passages.original: וְלָ֣מָּה תְנוּאוּן אֶת־ לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֵֽעֲבֹר֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to inspect the land.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the Gadites and Reubenites.
He reminded them about their fathers.
Their fathers acted in the same way.
I sent their fathers from Kadesh-barnea.
I told them to see the land.
Their fathers did this when I sent them.
passages.original: כֹּ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּשָׁלְחִ֥י אֹתָ֛ם מִקָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: For when your fathers went up to the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land that the LORD had given them.
passages.sermon:
The fathers of the Israelites went up to the Valley of Eshcol.
They saw the land there.
They discouraged the Israelites.
They told the Israelites not to enter the land.
The LORD had given this land to the Israelites.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲל֞וּ עַד־ נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכּ֗וֹל וַיִּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיָּנִ֕יאוּ אֶת־ לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְבִלְתִּי־ בֹא֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So the anger of the LORD was kindled that day, and He swore an oath, saying, ‘Because they did not follow Me wholeheartedly, not one of the men twenty years of age or older who came out of Egypt will see the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob— not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun—because they did follow the LORD wholeheartedly.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD became very angry that day.
He made a solemn promise.
He said, “None of the men who came out of Egypt will see the land.
These men are twenty years old or older.
I promised to give this land to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
But these men did not follow Me with all their hearts.
Only Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite will see the land.
Only Joshua son of Nun will see the land.
Caleb and Joshua followed the LORD with all their hearts.”
passages.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע לֵאמֹֽר׃ אִם־ יִרְא֨וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים הָעֹלִ֣ים מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה אֵ֚ת הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֛עְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י לֹא־ מִלְא֖וּ אַחֲרָֽי׃ בִּלְתִּ֞י כָּלֵ֤ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּה֙ הַקְּנִזִּ֔י וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־ נ֑וּן כִּ֥י מִלְא֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation who had done evil in His sight was gone.
passages.sermon:
The LORD became very angry with Israel.
The LORD punished Israel.
He made Israel wander in the wilderness.
They wandered for forty years.
The LORD waited until the whole generation was gone.
This generation had done evil in the sight of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְנִעֵם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה עַד־ תֹּם֙ כָּל־ הַדּ֔וֹר הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Now behold, you, a brood of sinners, have risen up in place of your fathers to further stoke the burning anger of the LORD against Israel.
passages.sermon:
You are a new generation of Israelites.
You have taken the place of your fathers.
You are a group of sinful men.
You add to the sins of those before you.
You increase the burning anger of the LORD against Israel.
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה קַמְתֶּ֗ם תַּ֚חַת אֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תַּרְבּ֖וּת אֲנָשִׁ֣ים חַטָּאִ֑ים לִסְפּ֣וֹת ע֗וֹד עַ֛ל חֲר֥וֹן אַף־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: For if you turn away from following Him, He will once again leave this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction.”
passages.sermon:
God led Israel in the wilderness for forty years because they did evil in His sight.
If you turn away from following God, He will act again.
He will leave this people in the wilderness again.
You will cause the destruction of all these people.
passages.original: כִּ֤י תְשׁוּבֻן֙ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֔יו וְיָסַ֣ף ע֔וֹד לְהַנִּיח֖וֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְשִֽׁחַתֶּ֖ם לְכָל־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃ס

passages.text: Then the Gadites and Reubenites approached Moses and said, “We want to build sheepfolds here for our livestock and cities for our little ones.
passages.sermon:
The Gadites and the Reubenites came to Moses.
They spoke to Moses.
They said, “We want to build sheepfolds here.
We will use these sheepfolds for our livestock.
We also want to build cities here.
We will use these cities for our little ones.”
passages.original: וַיִּגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ וַ֣יֹּאמְר֔וּ גִּדְרֹ֥ת צֹ֛אן נִבְנֶ֥ה לְמִקְנֵ֖נוּ פֹּ֑ה וְעָרִ֖ים לְטַפֵּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: But we will arm ourselves and be ready to go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them into their place. Meanwhile, our little ones will remain in the fortified cities for protection from the inhabitants of the land.
passages.sermon:
The Gadites and Reubenites spoke to Moses.
They said they would arm themselves for battle.
They would go ahead of the Israelites.
They would do this until all the Israelites reached their land.
Their children would stay behind.
Their children would live in strong, fortified cities.
These cities would protect their children from the people living in the land.
passages.original: וַאֲנַ֜חְנוּ נֵחָלֵ֣ץ חֻשִׁ֗ים לִפְנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִם־ הֲבִֽיאֹנֻ֖ם אֶל־ מְקוֹמָ֑ם וְיָשַׁ֤ב טַפֵּ֙נוּ֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הַמִּבְצָ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: We will not return to our homes until every Israelite has taken possession of his inheritance.
passages.sermon:
The Gadites and Reubenites spoke to Moses.
They said they would not go back to their homes.
They would stay away from their homes until every Israelite received his inheritance.
Each Israelite must take possession of his own land first.
Only then would the Gadites and Reubenites return to their homes.
passages.original: לֹ֥א נָשׁ֖וּב אֶל־ בָּתֵּ֑ינוּ עַ֗ד הִתְנַחֵל֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֖ישׁ נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Yet we will not have an inheritance with them across the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan.”
passages.sermon:
The tribes of Reuben and Gad spoke to Moses.
They said they would not receive land with the other Israelites west of the Jordan River.
They said their inheritance was already given to them.
Their inheritance was on the east side of the Jordan River.
passages.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א נִנְחַל֙ אִתָּ֔ם מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וָהָ֑לְאָה כִּ֣י בָ֤אָה נַחֲלָתֵ֙נוּ֙ אֵלֵ֔ינוּ מֵעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרָֽחָה׃פ

passages.text: Moses replied, “If you will do this—if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle, and if every one of your armed men crosses the Jordan before the LORD, until He has driven His enemies out before Him, then when the land is subdued before the LORD, you may return and be free of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. And this land will belong to you as a possession before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the people of Gad and Reuben.
He said, "If you do this thing, you must arm yourselves for battle before the LORD.
Every one of your fighting men must cross the Jordan before the LORD.
You must go until the LORD drives out His enemies from before Him.
When the LORD subdues the land before Him, you may return.
Then you will be free from obligation to the LORD and to Israel.
This land will belong to you as your possession before the LORD."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אִֽם־ תַּעֲשׂ֖וּן אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה אִם־ תֵּחָֽלְצ֛וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃ וְעָבַ֨ר לָכֶ֧ם כָּל־ חָל֛וּץ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַ֧ד הוֹרִישׁ֛וֹ אֶת־ אֹיְבָ֖יו מִפָּנָֽיו׃ וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֨ה הָאָ֜רֶץ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְאַחַ֣ר תָּשֻׁ֔בוּ וִהְיִיתֶ֧ם נְקִיִּ֛ים מֵיְהוָ֖ה וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ֠הָיְתָה הָאָ֨רֶץ הַזֹּ֥את לָכֶ֛ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: But if you do not do this, you will certainly sin against the LORD—and be assured that your sin will find you out.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the tribes of Gad and Reuben.
He said, “If you do not do what I have commanded, you will sin against the LORD.
You must know this.
Your sin will find you out.”
passages.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֤א תַעֲשׂוּן֙ כֵּ֔ן הִנֵּ֥ה חֲטָאתֶ֖ם לַיהוָ֑ה וּדְעוּ֙ חַטַּאתְכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּמְצָ֖א אֶתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your flocks, but do what you have promised.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the people of Gad and Reuben.
He told them to build cities for their children.
He told them to build pens for their flocks.
He commanded them to do what they had promised.
passages.original: בְּנֽוּ־ לָכֶ֤ם עָרִים֙ לְטַפְּכֶ֔ם וּגְדֵרֹ֖ת לְצֹנַאֲכֶ֑ם וְהַיֹּצֵ֥א מִפִּיכֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, “Your servants will do just as our lord commands.
passages.sermon:
The Gadites and the Reubenites spoke to Moses.
They said, "We are your servants."
We will do what you command.
We will obey our lord's instructions.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בְּנֵי־ גָד֙ וּבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ יַעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י מְצַוֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Our children, our wives, our livestock, and all our animals will remain here in the cities of Gilead.
passages.sermon:
The Gadites and Reubenites spoke to Moses.
They said what they would do.
Our children will stay here.
Our wives will stay here.
Our livestock will stay here.
All our animals will stay here.
They will remain in the cities of Gilead.
passages.original: טַפֵּ֣נוּ נָשֵׁ֔ינוּ מִקְנֵ֖נוּ וְכָל־ בְּהֶמְתֵּ֑נוּ יִֽהְיוּ־ שָׁ֖ם בְּעָרֵ֥י הַגִּלְעָֽד׃

passages.text: But your servants are equipped for war, and every man will cross over to the battle before the LORD, just as our lord says.”
passages.sermon:
The Gadites and Reubenites spoke to Moses.
They said, "We are your servants."
We are ready for war.
Every man will cross over before the LORD.
We will go to battle.
We will do just as you say.
passages.original: וַעֲבָדֶ֨יךָ יַֽעַבְר֜וּ כָּל־ חֲל֥וּץ צָבָ֛א לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י דֹּבֵֽר׃

passages.text: So Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua son of Nun, and to the family leaders of the tribes of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses gave orders about the Gadites and Reubenites.
He spoke to Eleazar the priest.
He spoke to Joshua son of Nun.
He spoke to the family leaders of the tribes of Israel.
passages.original: וַיְצַ֤ו לָהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֚ת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֑וּן וְאֶת־ רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And Moses said to them, “If the Gadites and Reubenites cross the Jordan with you, with every man armed for battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you are to give them the land of Gilead as a possession.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the Israelites.
Moses was their leader.
He said these words to them.
The tribe of Gad and the tribe of Reuben are part of Israel.
If the men of Gad and Reuben cross the Jordan River with you,
If every man is armed for battle before the LORD,
If they go with you to fight,
If the land is conquered before you,
Then you must give the land of Gilead to Gad and Reuben.
You must give it to them as their possession.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אִם־ יַעַבְר֣וּ בְנֵי־ גָ֣ד וּבְנֵי־ רְאוּבֵ֣ן׀ אִ֠תְּכֶם אֶֽת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֞ן כָּל־ חָל֤וּץ לַמִּלְחָמָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם לָהֶ֛ם אֶת־ אֶ֥רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֖ד לַאֲחֻזָּֽה׃

passages.text: But if they do not arm themselves and go across with you, then they must accept their possession among you in the land of Canaan.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the leaders of Israel.
He spoke about the tribes of Gad and Reuben.
He said, "If the men of Gad and Reuben do not cross the Jordan with you."
"If they do not go armed for battle with you."
"Then they must not receive land in Gilead."
"They must take their share of land among you."
"They will receive their possession in the land of Canaan."
passages.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֧א יַֽעַבְר֛וּ חֲלוּצִ֖ים אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְנֹֽאחֲז֥וּ בְתֹכְכֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃

passages.text: The Gadites and Reubenites replied, “As the LORD has spoken to your servants, so we will do.
passages.sermon:
The Gadites and the Reubenites answered Moses.
They spoke to him.
They said, “We are your servants.
The LORD has spoken to us.
We will do what the LORD has said.”
passages.original: וַיַּֽעֲנ֧וּ בְנֵי־ גָ֛ד וּבְנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ כֵּ֥ן נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃

passages.text: We will cross over into the land of Canaan armed before the LORD, that we may have our inheritance on this side of the Jordan.”
passages.sermon:
The Gadites and Reubenites spoke to Moses.
They said they would obey the LORD.
They said, “We will cross over the Jordan River.
We will go into the land of Canaan.
We will go armed.
We will go before the LORD.
We will help the other Israelites take the land.
Our own inheritance will be on the east side of the Jordan River.”
passages.original: נַ֣חְנוּ נַעֲבֹ֧ר חֲלוּצִ֛ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְאִתָּ֙נוּ֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת נַחֲלָתֵ֔נוּ מֵעֵ֖בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

passages.text: So Moses gave to the Gadites, to the Reubenites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan—the land including its cities and the territory surrounding them.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses gave land to the Gadites.
Moses gave land to the Reubenites.
Moses gave land to the half-tribe of Manasseh, who were descendants of Joseph.
Moses gave them the kingdom of Sihon.
Sihon was king of the Amorites.
Moses gave them the kingdom of Og.
Og was king of Bashan.
Moses gave them the land with its cities.
Moses gave them the territory around those cities.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֣ם׀ מֹשֶׁ֡ה לִבְנֵי־ גָד֩ וְלִבְנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֜ן וְלַחֲצִ֣י׀ שֵׁ֣בֶט׀ מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן־ יוֹסֵ֗ף אֶת־ מַמְלֶ֙כֶת֙ סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֶת־ מַמְלֶ֔כֶת ע֖וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן הָאָ֗רֶץ לְעָרֶ֙יהָ֙ בִּגְבֻלֹ֔ת עָרֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: And the Gadites built up Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer, Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah, Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran as fortified cities, and they built folds for their flocks.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Gad received land east of the Jordan River.
The Gadites built the city of Dibon.
They built the city of Ataroth.
They built the city of Aroer.
They built the city of Atroth-shophan.
They built the city of Jazer.
They built the city of Jogbehah.
They built the city of Beth-nimrah.
They built the city of Beth-haran.
They made these cities strong with walls.
They also built pens for their flocks.
passages.original: וַיִּבְנ֣וּ בְנֵי־ גָ֔ד אֶת־ דִּיבֹ֖ן וְאֶת־ עֲטָרֹ֑ת וְאֵ֖ת עֲרֹעֵֽר׃ וְאֶת־ עַטְרֹ֥ת שׁוֹפָ֛ן וְאֶת־ יַעְזֵ֖ר וְיָגְבֳּהָֽה׃ וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית נִמְרָ֖ה וְאֶת־ בֵּ֣ית הָרָ֑ן עָרֵ֥י מִבְצָ֖ר וְגִדְרֹ֥ת צֹֽאן׃

passages.text: The Reubenites built up Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim, as well as Nebo and Baal-meon (whose names were changed), and Sibmah. And they renamed the cities they rebuilt.
passages.sermon:
The Reubenites were one of the tribes of Israel.
They built up the city of Heshbon.
They built up the city of Elealeh.
They built up the city of Kiriathaim.
They built up the city of Nebo.
They built up the city of Baal-meon.
They changed the names of Nebo and Baal-meon.
They built up the city of Sibmah.
They gave new names to the cities they rebuilt.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֤י רְאוּבֵן֙ בָּנ֔וּ אֶת־ חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ אֶלְעָלֵ֑א וְאֵ֖ת קִרְיָתָֽיִם׃ וְאֶת־ נְב֞וֹ וְאֶת־ בַּ֧עַל מְע֛וֹן מֽוּסַבֹּ֥ת שֵׁ֖ם וְאֶת־ שִׂבְמָ֑ה וַיִּקְרְא֣וּ בְשֵׁמֹ֔ת אֶת־ שְׁמ֥וֹת הֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנֽוּ׃

passages.text: The descendants of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
passages.sermon:
Machir was the son of Manasseh.
Machir had descendants.
The descendants of Machir went to Gilead.
They captured Gilead.
The Amorites lived in Gilead.
The descendants of Machir drove out the Amorites from Gilead.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ בְּנֵ֨י מָכִ֧יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה גִּלְעָ֖דָה וַֽיִּלְכְּדֻ֑הָ וַיּ֖וֹרֶשׁ אֶת־ הָאֱמֹרִ֥י אֲשֶׁר־ בָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: So Moses gave Gilead to the clan of Machir son of Manasseh, and they settled there.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Machir was the son of Manasseh.
Moses gave the land of Gilead to Machir.
Machir and his descendants settled in Gilead.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לְמָכִ֖יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, went and captured their villages and called them Havvoth-jair.
passages.sermon:
Jair was a descendant of Manasseh.
Jair went to the villages.
Jair captured the villages.
Jair named the villages Havvoth-jair.
passages.original: וְיָאִ֤יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁה֙ הָלַ֔ךְ וַיִּלְכֹּ֖ד אֶת־ חַוֺּתֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶתְהֶ֖ן חַוֺּ֥ת יָאִֽיר׃

passages.text: And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its villages and called it Nobah, after his own name.
passages.sermon:
Nobah was a man among the Israelites.
Nobah went to Kenath.
Kenath was a city with surrounding villages.
Nobah captured Kenath and its villages.
Nobah gave the city a new name.
He called it Nobah, after his own name.
passages.original: וְנֹ֣בַח הָלַ֔ךְ וַיִּלְכֹּ֥ד אֶת־ קְנָ֖ת וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיִּקְרָ֧א לָ֦ה נֹ֖בַח בִּשְׁמֽוֹ׃פ
